thread:
Maya (Sales): Greenline flagged a blocker in the security questionnaire: they need BYO-CMK on HSM with per-key rotation windows and an exception path. Can we confirm feasibility for the POC?
Jordan (SE): Paste their asks? quick bullets pls.
Claire (Greenline-IT): Sure — key points:
- FIPS 140-2/3 HSM attestation and cert chain
- Import BYO keys (wrapped import) and support PKCS#8 unwrap flow
- Rotation window per key + legal exception workflow
- Multi-region mirrored keys with sync SLA
- Audit log retention 7 years (they want proof)
- Ops escalation when auto-rotation fails (pager + ticketing)
- Expected QPS and cost model for HSM ops
Maya (Sales): Thanks. Jordan, what's our short answer for POC?
Jordan (SE): TL;DR: POC supports wrapped BYO imports, HSM-backed keys on Dedicated/Private only, attestation docs available. Rotation exceptions possible via an approval workflow that sets a temporary "no-auto-rotate" flag. We'll need to show the runbook for escalation.
Sam (CryptoEng): Tech detail: our HSMs use vendor attestation. We can produce the cert chain and an attestation statement. Key rotation is policy-driven: default = automatic rotate. Exception creates a policy override with TTL and requires dual-approval. We'll add a post-rotation hook that flushes KV caches to avoid stale signatures.
Priya (Security): From security POV: recommend symmetric key rotation <= 90d, asymmetric signing <= 365d. If exceptions are granted, require: MFA & dual-approval for manual rotates, SIEM-forwarding of audit logs, and restricted RBAC. Also need to confirm how long exception TTLs can be (legal input).
Alex (Billing): Pricing: HSM ops billed as ops-per-1000 + hourly HSM seat on Dedicated. For a POC we can provide a trial credit estimate. Claire — what's your expected peak during POC vs prod?
Claire (Greenline-IT): Prod peak: 40 encrypt QPS, 5 decrypt/sign QPS, ~2000 ops/day for tokenization. POC will mimic ~5% traffic. Also we need S3 export for long-term audit retention.
Alex (Billing): Ok 40 QPS sustained becomes several million ops/day. For POC it's small, but callouts: committed tiers reduce per-op significantly. I'll draft numbers after we get exact POC traffic shape.
Jordan (SE): On-call escalation proposal:
1) auto-rotation fails -> alert to redwood infra-sre
2) after 15m if unresolved -> create ticket to Greenline contacts using template
3) after additional 45m -> manual escalation to oncall lead + cross-org pager.
Example runbook snippet:
```
- detect: rotation-failure
  notify: #eng-oncall
  wait: 15m
- detect: unresolved
  action: create-ticket(template=rotate-fail)
  wait: 45m
- action: escalate-to-customer-pager
```
Sam (CryptoEng): Note: if we grant a manual-rotate exception, we must guarantee KV cache invalidation and atomic swap across replicas. We'll add a hook that triggers cache flush and version pinning. Also for mirrored keys we use async replication with configurable staleness windows; SLA depends on region pairing.
Priya (Security): Audit retention 7y: our default encrypted logs retention is 1y. For 7y we must export to customer-owned S3 or a customer-paid long-term archive. Legal needs to sign off for export and longer retention.
Claire (Greenline-IT): We will use our S3. We'll provide ARN after legal review. Attestation: we need the hardware cert chain + last 3 months of ceremony notes for POC.
Sam (CryptoEng): We can provide cert chain and an anonymized ceremony summary for POC. Full ceremony logs are available under NDA for production. I'll attach the attestation pdf to the ticket.
Maya (Sales): Action items: Sam attach attestation and ceremony summary; Alex post a POC ballpark; Jordan prepare runbook + exception workflow doc; Priya list mandatory controls for exception; Claire confirm legal TTL and share S3 ARN.
deploy-bot: Created cluster redwood-poc-greenline-2026-03 and emailed creds to maya@redwood.com — please rotate creds after onboarding.
Maya (Sales): I'll schedule a Thursday sync with Greenline to walk through runbook and pricing. Anything else blocking from our side?
Priya (Security): Confirm whether Greenline will accept S3 exports into their AWS account (preferred) or require Redwood-hosted archive. Also need NDA clause for ceremony logs.
Claire (Greenline-IT): We'll accept S3 export into our account. NDA for full logs OK.
Alex (Billing): I'll post a high-level POC vs committed pricing ranges in the sales thread by EOD, with commit thresholds for Dedicated HSM.
Jordan (SE): I'll open the runbook PR in eng-oncall and ping relevant oncall leads. Will link once ready.
Maya (Sales): Great — marking thread for the deal POC checklist. :thumbsup:
